svg.title: Attention architectures on Ascend: VSA, Veda, VDN and Spark-H3
svg.desc: Four parallel attention flow diagrams with separate sparse routing and attention data paths. VSA, Veda and Spark-H3 use custom Ascend C kernels. VDN uses CANN attention with NPU Graph scans.
svg.text: KV64 pairs · dense prefix · 80% video sparsity
